item.title: Gophers’ coach P.J. Fleck getting $700k bonus after 8-5 season
item.description: The University of Minnesota’s Board of Regents will meet this week, and they’re expected to approve a $700,000 bonus for football coach P.J. Fleck.P.J. Fleck contract amendment, not an extensionFleck will receive a $700,000 bonus, which will increase his salary to $7.9 million annually. That will make Fleck the 10th-highest paid coach in the 18-team Big Ten Conference.The Gophers are coming off an 8-5 season in 2025, and their sixth straight bowl win under Fleck. item.title: Renee Good shooting: Weekend protests mark 1 month since fatal ICE incident
item.description: Crowds gathered to remember Renee Good Saturday to mark one month since her death. One of the protests led to dozens of arrests.
